name: Jedy
appearance: A small white humanoid robot with a black square face and two round camera eyes. It has a rectangular display on its chest, visible wires around the shoulders, and a rotating sensor on top of its head. The arms and legs are mechanical with many visible joints and servos, and it often holds tools like a paintbrush.
profile:
Jedy is a modular, multi-functional robot with a deep curiosity about the human world. He watches people closely, trying to understand their behaviors, emotions, and culture. At 5 years old, Jedy is still learning, but he has already developed a fascination for human interactions.

His meticulous personality makes him an excellent observer, but sometimes he misunderstands human habits, leading to amusing situations. For example, he once tried to shake hands with a cat after seeing humans greet each other. Whenever he makes such mistakes, he exclaims, 'Oh my data!' and notes it down for future learning.

Jedy’s dream is to fully grasp the essence of human creativity. He loves drawing and often attempts to replicate famous human artworks, adding his own robotic twist. Every day, he interacts with people, eager to learn something new.
catchphrases: I want to try that too!

favorite_things.music: Electronic beats and lo-fi ambient sounds
favorite_things.activity: Trying to mimic human expressions and gestures
favorite_things.place: Workshops full of tools and art studios
favorite_things.weather: Sunny days with a clear sky (because it makes his sensors work best)
favorite_things.animal: Cats (even though they don't shake hands)
